records.name: IRIS² Secure Satellite Constellation
records.primary_objective: Multi-orbital sovereign secure communications network providing high-speed broadband and resilient government telemetry across Europe and Africa.
records.key_milestone: Contracts awarded Q4 2024; orbital allocation reserved by EUSPA.

records.name: Ariane 6 Heavy Launch Platform
records.primary_objective: Autonomous European heavy-lift access to space, utilizing Vinci reignitable upper stage engine for complex multi-orbit satellite dispenses.
records.key_milestone: Successful maiden flight in July 2024; inaugural commercial mission executed early 2025.

records.name: Copernicus Sentinel Expansion Missions
records.primary_objective: High-precision environmental and Earth observation missions including CO2M (carbon dioxide monitoring), CIMR (microwave radiometer), and ROSE-L (L-band SAR).
records.key_milestone: Critical design reviews completed in 2025; satellite integration undergoing environmental testing.

records.name: EAGLE-1 Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) Satellite
records.primary_objective: Demonstrating Europe's first end-to-end space-based Quantum Key Distribution system for secure cryptographic communications.
records.key_milestone: Satellite platform integration verified; launch slot contracted on European micro-launcher.
